title: Turkish-Style Boregi with Rocket Salad
description: A Turkish-inspired boregi recipe served with a refreshing rocket salad. Perfect as a snack or light lunch.
instructions: Unroll the boregi dough and cut into squares.
Place a tablespoon of feta cheese in the center of each square.
Add a few rocket leaves on top of the cheese.
Fold the dough into triangles and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with su (water) and bake for 15-20 minutes.
While the boregi is baking, prepare the rocket salad by combining the rocket leaves, olives, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve the boregi warm with the rocket salad on the side.
